topic: Buying your first business with no money down, for owners who've never done a deal
evidence: “I have never bought a business before” (24) and “Buying companies” (39) are the top two applicant answers; first-deal questions recur in the notes.
demand_phrase: how to buy your first business with no money
format: Whiteboard masterclass (the format of your best video), 16–20 min
titles: How to Buy Your First Business With No Money Down ($1M+ Owners)
Never Bought a Business? The 4-Step Path for Owners Doing $1M+

thumbnails.visual: Josh at a whiteboard with four boxes: target → debt → seller note → rollover
Close-up, slight smile, a ‘SOLD’ sign over his shoulder

hook: If your business already does a million a year, you don't need a war chest to buy your next one. You need a target that makes money, and four things I'm about to draw on this board.

outline.intro_callouts: This is for owners of profitable businesses doing $1M+ who have never bought one. If you're pre-revenue or under $1M, watch the one on whether you're big enough first.
logic_ladder: Why buying beats building once you're past $1M
What you're really buying: cash flow, customers, a team
Who sells: owners who want out and have no successor
How it's paid for: commercial debt, seller finance and seller rollover
The test every deal must pass: profit covers repayments about 1.5×
What the first 90 days look like
outline.callbacks: Back to the promise: your first deal, without your own cash, if it passes the 1.5× test.
outline.proof: An illustrative deal drawn on the whiteboard, labelled illustrative.

cta.line: Next, watch exactly where the money comes from.
